# SportDGX

> Independent sports and fan-travel site by MainEntry LLC (Kansas City). New daily articles for US fans: where to watch, schedules, tickets, stadiums and travel. Not affiliated with any league or team.

## SportDGX Insider articles

- [Where to Watch the Liga MX Liguilla in the USA (Apertura 2026)](https://sportdgx.com/articles/liga-mx-liguilla-where-to-watch-usa): Where to watch the Liga MX Liguilla in the US: channels, streaming apps and dates for the Apertura 2026 quarterfinals, semifinals and final.
